content: Ye Yoyɑkimu, Yosiɑsin bii Yudɑn sinɑ boko u bɑndu di, yen sɔ̃ɔ mɛɛ terɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u kɑ Yeremi ɡɑri yini kuɑ u nɛɛ,

ɑmɛniwɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡeruɑ nɑ nɛɛ, ɑ yɔ̃ro sɑ̃ɑ yerun yɑɑrɑ mini. Tɔn be bɑ koo nɑ sɑɑ Yudɑn wusu kpuron di bu kɑ mɑn sɑ̃, kpɑ ɑ bu ɡɑri yi kpuro sɔ̃ yi nɑ nɛɛ, ɑ bu sɔ̃. Bɑɑ yin tiɑ ɑ ku rɑ bure.
Bɑ̀ n wurɑ bɑ nun swɑɑ dɑki, mɑ bɑ wurɑ ben dɔɔ sɔɔ, bɑ ben kom kɔ̃sum deri, kɔ̃sɑ ye nɑ rɑɑ ɡɔ̃ru doke n bu kuɑ, kon ye deri.
A bu sɔ̃ɔwɔ ɑ nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡeruɑ. Nɑ nɛɛ, bu mɑn swɑɑ dɑkio bu nɛn woodɑbɑ swĩi ye nɑ bu wɛ̃,
kpɑ bu ku nɛn ɡɔrobun ɡɑri ɑtɑfiiru ko. Nɑ rɑ be bu ɡɔrie sɑɑ yellun di, ɑdɑmɑ bɑ ǹ bu swɑɑ dɑki.
Yen sɔ̃, kon sɑ̃ɑ yee te kɑm koosiɑ nɡe mɛ nɑ Siloɡiru kuɑ, kpɑ n de bwesenu kpuro nu wuu ɡen yĩsiru siɑ nù n bɔ̃rumɔ.
Yɑ̃ku kowobu kɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔbu kɑ wuun tɔmbu bɑ Yeremin ɡɑri yi nuɑ yi u ɡerumɔ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ.

Ye u ɡɑri yi ɡeruɑ u kpɑ yi Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn yiire u tɔn be kpuro sɔ̃ mi, yerɑ yɑ̃ku kowo be, kɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔ be, kɑ sere wuun tɔn be bɑ tie kpuro bɑ nɑ bɑ nùn sɛ̃re. Bɑ ɡbɑ̃sukumɔ bɑ mɔ̀, kɑɑ ɡbiwɑ.
Tɔmbu kpuro bɑ nɑ bɑ Yeremi mɛnnɛ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yeru mi, bɑ mɔ̀, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ɑ ɡerumɔ kɑ Yinni Gusunɔ yĩsiru ɑ mɔ̀, sɑ̃ɑ yee teni tɑ koo kɑm kowɑ nɡe Siloɡiru, kpɑ Yerusɑlɛmu yu ko bɑnsu.
Ye Yudɑn wiruɡibu bɑ nuɑ mɛ, yerɑ bɑ seewɑ sinɑ kpɑɑrun di bɑ dɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ, mɑ bɑ sinɑ sɑ̃ɑ yee ten kɔnnɔwɔ ɡe bɑ sokumɔ kɔnnɔ kpɔɔ.
Mɑ yɑ̃ku kowo be, kɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔ be, bɑ wiruɡibu kɑ tɔn be bɑ tie kpuro sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, n weenɛwɑ bu durɔ wini ɡo. Domi ɡɑri kɑmwɑ u wuu ɡeni ɡerusimɔ. Bɛɛn tii i mɑɑ yi nuɑ kɑ bɛɛn swɑɑ.
Mɑ Yeremi u wiruɡii be kɑ tɔn be kpuro sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u mɑn ɡɔrimɑ n kɑ ɡɑri ko sɑ̃ɑ yee teni kɑ wuu ɡenin sɔ̃, nɡe mɛ i nuɑ kpuro.
I ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsio kpɑ i kom kɔ̃sum deri. I Gusunɔ bɛɛn Yinnin ɡɑri swɑɑ dɑkio, kpɑ u kɔ̃sɑ ye deri ye u rɑɑ kĩ u bɛɛ kuɑ.
Adɑmɑ nɛ wee bɛɛn nɔmɑɔ, i kɑ mɑn koowo nɡe mɛ n bɛɛ dɛnde.
I yɛ̃ mɑ nɑ ǹ tɑɑrɛ ɡɑɑ mɔ. Yen sɔ̃, ì n mɑn ɡo, nɛn yɛm mu kuɑ bɛɛ kɑ bɛɛn wuu ɡen sɔmunu. Domi kɑ ɡem Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u mɑn ɡɔrimɑ n kɑ bɛɛ ɡɑri yini kpuro sɔ̃.
Yerɑ wiruɡii be, kɑ tɔn be bɑ tie bɑ yɑ̃ku kowo be, kɑ sɔmɔ be sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, n ǹ weenɛ su durɔ wi ɡo domi kɑ Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinnin yĩsirɑ u ɡɑri yini ɡeruɑ.
Mɑ wuu ɡen ɡuro ɡurobu ɡɑbu bɑ seewɑ bɑ tɔn wɔru ɡe sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ,
Misee Mɔresɛtiɡii u rɑɑ Gusunɔn ɡɑri ɡeruɑ Yudɑn sinɑ boko Esekiɑsin wɑɑti u nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ Gusunɔ, wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni u ɡeruɑ. U nɛɛ,

content.text: bɑ koo Yerusɑlɛmu bwiiyɑ nɡe ɡberu,
kpɑ yu ko nɡe kpee ni bɑ subɑ,
kpɑ ɡuu tèn wɔllɔ bɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yee te bɑnɑ,
tu dɑ̃nu kpi n ko dɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ bɔkɔ.

content: Yudɑbɑ kɑ ben sinɑ boko Esekiɑsi wi, bɑ Misee wi ɡo? Esekiɑsi wi, u ǹ Yinni Gusunɔ nɑsie? Nɡe u ǹ Yinni Gusunɔ suuru kɑnɛ ro? Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u kɔ̃sɑ ye deri ye u rɑɑ kĩ u bu kuɑ. Yerɑ i ko de bɛsɛ, su tii durum bɑkɑ yeni sɔbi?
Yoyɑkimu
u Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Uri ɡo

N deemɑ Yoyɑkimun wɑɑti ye sɔɔ, durɔ ɡoo mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ wi bɑ mɔ̀ Uri, Semɑyɑ Kiriɑti Yɑrimuɡiin bii. Durɔ wi, u rɑ ɡɑri ɡere kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn yĩsiru. Mɑ u ɡɑri tee yi ɡeruɑ win tii, wuu ɡenin sɔ̃ nɡe mɛ Yeremi u ɡeruɑ mi. Mɑ Yoyɑkimu kɑ win tɑbu durɔbu kɑ mɑɑ win sinɑ ɑsɑkpɔbu bɑ ɡɑri yi nuɑ. Yerɑ sinɑ boko wi, u kɑsu u Uri ɡo. Ye Uri u nuɑ mɛ, u bɛrum soorɑ, mɑ u kpikiru suɑ u dɑ Eɡibitiɔ.
Yerɑ Yoyɑkimu u Ɛlinɑtɑni Akɑborin bii ɡɔrɑ Eɡibitiɔ kɑ tɔmbu ɡɑbu sɑnnu bu kɑ Uri mwɑɑmɑ.
Mɑ bɑ Uri wi mwɑɑmɑ bɑ kɑ nùn nɑ sinɑ bokon mi. Mɑ u derɑ bɑ nùn ɡo kɑ tɑkobi. Yerɑ bɑ win ɡoru kɑre mi bɑ rɑ tɔn dirobu sike.
Adɑmɑ Akikɑmu Sɑfɑnin bii u yɔ̃rɑwɑ kɑ Yeremi mɑ u yinɑ bu tɔn be Yeremi nɔmu bɛriɑ bu ɡo.
Yeremi
u suɡu sɔndi win seru wɔllɔ
